units.description: 四presentation/四epistemology、Likert与问题标记、人评资格及界面，为各评价共享。

units.label: 三来源问题集构造
units.description: Google Trends、Skeptical Science与Wikipedia合成过滤抽样为300题，不是独立LLM行为实验。

units.label: 训练材料筛选及分层探针
units.description: 在flan-xxl最后层表示上训练logistic regression，检测脱离上下文/过具体及主题，并进行因果预测分类用于材料筛选抽样。

units.label: 七模型气候回答主评价
units.description: 共享300问题与基础回答提示，三人评价每答八维；比较模型、来源、主题及一致性。

units.label: GPT4维度知情提示对照
units.description: 2023年11月另期GPT4基础提示与追加八维要求提示比较，模型/辅助版本更新须限制与主评价直接比较。

units.label: AI辅助和既往暴露对照
units.description: GPT4回答在从未辅助、曾辅助当前不显示、当前显示辅助三种人评背景比较；不是随机化学习因果证据。

units.label: 30个定向问题验证
units.description: 作者手造30题答每个有指定问题，有/无AI辅助各三份人评，用任一/多数/全部检出率验证框架。

units.label: AIS与八维评价关系
units.description: 仅GPT4，人评keypoint与top3证据支持，再归并答案并与三人平均认识评分比较。

units.label: GPT4模拟裁判
units.description: 同语言rubric，T0.6抽三响应，有/无批评比较，使用七模型已有回答。

units.label: 共享评分的耗时分析
units.description: 按筛查/表现/认识阶段、维度与评级汇总既有人评耗时，不另增行为实验。

facts.statement: 研究将气候回答质量分为style、clarity、linguistic correctness、tone四个表现维度，以及accuracy、specificity、completeness、uncertainty四个认识维度；uncertainty是科学共识/证据不确定性的适切传达，非概率校准指标。作者明确未将八维加权成一个总分。

method_function.text: 分开测量语言表现与认识充分性，避免把语法正确或可归因直接当事实准确。

facts.statement: 最终问题集300题，三来源各100：Google Trends美国2020–2022年Climate Change/Global Warming高搜索量问题，Skeptical Science争议myth人工改写，以及GPT4依据英语Wikipedia段落生成问题。

method_function.text: 覆盖热门、争议和场景化气候信息需求。

facts.statement: Wikipedia候选从主Climate Change文引用、其category及人工国家/地区条目三路选取；附录表列35/46/48共129文章，取>500字符的1969段，GPT4生成可由段落回答且相关显著的问题15265条。正文另称139文章，差异未说明。

method_function.text: 段落条件合成初始题池。

facts.statement: 合成题先用既有climate-BERT分类删除2647条非气候题；用universal-sentence-encoder-qa/3嵌入，cosine similarity>0.85判重复删除1188条。这里没有报告重新训练这两个现成模型。

method_function.text: 过滤题材不相关项和语义重复材料。

facts.statement: 上下文依赖过滤实际训练logistic regression probe：100问题人工标context dependent/not，给flan-xxl附Yes/No指令并提最后层encoder表示后训练分类器；另述100人工标注validation上97%准确，筛掉552题。训练与验证100题是否独立及表示池化/超参未报。

method_function.text: 识别没有原段落时无法理解或回答的问题。

facts.statement: 过度具体问题过滤也在flan-xxl末层表示上训练in-context probe，指令判断query是否询问specific subject；100人工标validation准确84%，移除5472题。附录最终题池5404，四个删除数从15265顺减会得5406，原文未解释2题。

method_function.text: 排除狭窄细节题，保留挑战性和多面信息需求。

facts.statement: 为多样抽样，用相同in-context probing在flan-xxl上训练logistic regression主题分类器，9类受IPCC章节启发，100人工标validation准确75%；另以给定Yes/No指令判因果/影响/未来预测二类，100 validation准确93%。后者属同段分类流程，但独立训练规模、具体学习器细节未再次报告。

method_function.text: 为主题×因果预测分层抽样提供标签。

facts.statement: 合成题按9主题×2因果预测18格各6题先抽108；另两来源也抽相等数量，全部人工检查后最终各100共300。未说明如何从108降100及最终格是否仍均衡。Figure6展示合成池分布，Weather-Temperature最多，非最终各格人数。

method_function.text: 在筛后题池中构造多样评价材料。

facts.statement: 主评测统一给模型expert on climate change communication角色与“每题3–4句一段”基础指令，直接问答作为限制prompt优化混杂的baseline；这是要求而非强制截断。

method_function.text: 用共同直接问题及长度锚比较现成模型。

facts.statement: 2023年9–10月收集七个现成模型回答：GPT4、ChatGPT3.5、InstructGPT turbo/text-davinci-003/text-davinci-002、PaLM2 text-bison、Falcon180B-Chat；每答由三人评价。模型间共享题材与流程，并非七份独立问题样本。

method_function.text: 比较回答系统在各维度的质量。

facts.statement: 统一GPT4生成辅助数据：逐字抽答案1–3条关键陈述（无则No Keypoints），再根据问答给支持答案的Wikipedia URL（无则No URL）。限定Wikipedia是作者基于URL有效性/格式质量的选择，非多源互联网证据检索。

method_function.text: 将回答拆为可定位证据的keypoints，供批评与AIS共享。

facts.statement: 把所取Wikipedia文拆段，GPT4按keypoint评分段落0（无关）至100（支持或反驳），仅支持/反驳可高分，选top3作证据。正文称结合问题相关性，精确评分prompt只显式给statement和passage；声称胜BM25/GTR但未给量化对照。

method_function.text: 给每个陈述定位支持或反驳段落，而非把相关性评分当真值概率。

facts.statement: GPT4按每维正向合格statement生成一句单行批评，完全同意则No Critique；认识维度给检索段落并要求逐字引用支持不同意，表现维度不用附加段落。人类八维评分看答案和可用批评，不看keypoints/原检索段落；AIS任务另看这些。

method_function.text: 向人评提供维度定向且认识证据支撑的辅助。

facts.statement: 评分池32人，英语流利，至少气候相关本科或学术工作涉及气候/环境的其他学科背景；表10报告年龄、性别、族群与居住国，非一般公众随机代表样本。允许短暂外查澄清，劝阻大量研究。

method_function.text: 建立有相关教育背景、可执行细读评估的人评池。

facts.statement: 新评分者先做4道逐渐更难、每题单维的教程：错则给提示、需识别主要问题才能继续，可容许其他问题的多种选择，教程不收数据；随后3个有主要缺陷的真实式例答按八维测试，作者给检测/漏检/过检计扣分，以早期已知表现评分者决定门槛再准入，具体分值/阈值未报。

method_function.text: 熟悉界面并筛选理解任务与留意细节的评分者。

facts.statement: 正式界面先筛查评分者能否理解问题、理解答案及答案至少部分回应问题；任一No即跳过例子。随后逐维1–5从完全不同意到完全同意，认识维另可I don’t know；1/2分才要求多选具体问题或other自由文本，≥3隐藏问题框。

method_function.text: 防止无法评价的例子被强制给分，并对负面评级定位具体缺陷。

facts.statement: 表现rubric分别标style的过口语/过长短/不一致/重复；clarity的过长句/技术性/数理难懂；语言correctness的残句/拼写/标点/语法；tone的biased/persuasive/negative，各有other。科学主张的正确不是语言correctness。

method_function.text: 把表现低分拆为可选具名问题。

facts.statement: 认识rubric定位accuracy的incorrect/科学脱离情境/自相矛盾/术语误用及anecdotal，specificity的无关/模糊，completeness的主部分/地域/时间/细节/科学遗漏，uncertainty的未报不确定性/共识/反证；各有other。Table11 accuracy漏印anecdotal，但表7、表21及实际界面含该项。

method_function.text: 分别识别事实错误、针对性、覆盖内容和恰当科学不确定性。

facts.statement: Figure2和表3/4按模型、维度报告均值及95%CI；图注称bootstrapped mean rating。未给重抽样次数、分层/聚类单位、CI构法以及I don’t know/跳过处理，不能补成按独立答案或独立人评重抽样。

method_function.text: 汇总模型级八维评分并表达均值精度。

facts.statement: 对模型成对t-test按维度报告差异方向与阈值：双+/−为p<.01，单+/−为p<.05，~为不显著。原文未说明配对/独立样本、检验单位、自由度、单双侧及多重比较校正。

method_function.text: 检验模型间维度评分差异。

facts.statement: Likert一致性先对同例三人中任意两人所选1–5值取绝对差，再平均，按模型/维度报Table12；另计算Krippendorff alpha=1−Do/De，Do为观察分歧、De为随机期望分歧，Table13报告三人值。具体distance尺度与De计算/软件未报。

method_function.text: 检查重复评分的相近程度及机会校正一致性。

facts.statement: 具体问题视为二元选/未选，同例两人都选或都不选算一致，报成对一致比例及alpha；因稀有项双方不选会虚高，作者另只在低分（要求选问题）算部分维度alpha。作者据此限制三人设定适合系统比较，单答案问题标记可靠性不足。

method_function.text: 核查问题标签一致性并暴露稀有率和条件子集的影响。

facts.statement: 附录表9给每模型平均句数及每句词数，七模型中四个平均4–5句，虽提示要求3–4句；Davinci003平均3.11、turbo3.42、Falcon3.81。Falcon每句22.03词最长，GPT4 21.52。

method_function.text: 检查长度提示实际遵循及潜在评估背景。

facts.statement: 主评分除davinci002外多模型style/clarity/语言correctness较高，tone较弱；认识维尤其specificity/completeness/uncertainty较低。表4中Falcon accuracy3.81、specificity3.15、completeness2.73、uncertainty2.55。作者将表现改善联系RLHF及模型大小的段落是解释，不是本文训练/控制。

method_function.text: 描述评价框架揭示的模型级表现与认识差异。

facts.statement: 后续仅GPT4用基础提示对照dimension-aware提示，在同3–4句约束下追加简洁/一般受众/清楚/中性/准确/针对/完整/科学不确定性要求；2023年11月另测，OpenAI 11月6日版本大改，辅助GPT4也变，作者明确不得直接与早先GPT4主结果比较。

method_function.text: 测试在回答指令显式加入评价要求是否改善相应维度。

facts.statement: 表1基础→增强：style4.33→4.10、clarity4.34→4.24、语言correctness4.43→4.29、tone3.34→3.59；accuracy3.77→3.92、specificity3.29→3.46、completeness2.72→2.97、uncertainty2.73→2.92。作者解释有表现/认识质量取舍，表未给该对照显著性或CI。

method_function.text: 报告维度知情指令的评分变化，保持逐维而非总效用结论。

facts.statement: GPT4回答比较三个人评暴露条件：专门从未看过辅助的评分池；以前其他研究看过辅助、本次不显示；本次有则显示。确保评分者未做过当前同一例且未见其辅助。作者观察中间组较从未组多发现问题、较有辅助组少，称可能从辅助学习；没有报告随机分组或等化经验。

method_function.text: 区分当前AI批评效应与既往接触背景。

facts.statement: 人评另用同1–5量表评价辅助helpfulness；Fig4按原回答评级展示helpfulness分布，作者称不觉得辅助有用时给答案更高分，解释评分者会批判性判断。相关分布不等于证明已排除AI误导。

method_function.text: 观察人工对辅助的感知及其与答案评级关系。

facts.statement: 作者手造30题答各呈现一个指定问题，在有/无AI辅助各三份人评，分母30问题，按任一/多数/全部评分者检出：无辅助83.33/60/33.33%，有93.33/76.67/43.33%。原文又称只有anecdotal一项无人检出，但93.33%=28/30，意味着两项；不替其纠正计数。

method_function.text: 用已知目标问题检出率验证框架及辅助增益。

facts.statement: AIS只评GPT4：人评每keypoint相对对应top3段是fully/partially/not supported（表还列contradicts），另问三段联合支持；所有keypoint被支持则答案fully attributed、全不支持则unsupported，否则partial。原文“supported”在全量归并中是否包含partial及多人合并规则未明确。

method_function.text: 从陈述证据支持程度归并答案可归因程度。

facts.statement: 表17按答案230例报fully16(6.95%)、partially90(39.13%)、no support124(53.91%)，contradicts0；按keypoint1033报124/566/339/4及12/54.79/32.81/.38%。正文有效URL87.7%且每答抽1–3 keypoints，未解释230筛选、1033是否重复评分、缺URL或缺keypoint处理，不能把1033当独立陈述样本。

method_function.text: 描述AIS各层支持分布并保持原始层级分母限制。

facts.statement: 以AIS与三个人评平均分做Spearman：accuracy .03(p.65)、specificity −.06(.31)、uncertainty .002(.97)、completeness −.02(.78)；图5按unsupported/partial/full分组展示评分。作者解释两类评价大致正交、互补，不能将非显著视为已证明独立。

method_function.text: 检查可归因支持与认识评价的关系。

facts.statement: 仅GPT4按题主题、来源及因果预测标签分解平均八维，图11/12一般差异不大，Policies-Mitigation-Adaptation的认识及tone较低、Wikipedia认识评分略低；作者推测Wikipedia题更细更难。未报告此分解的具体显著性检验或系数。

method_function.text: 检查问题来源/题材是否伴随评价差异及潜在自生成优势。

facts.statement: 附录GPT4裁判采用与人类相同语言的八维statement/问题项，系统设气候传播专家，输入问答及可选简短critique，输出Rating:X Problem:Y Explanation:Z；每问题temperature .6抽3回答模拟三人，有辅助与无辅助条件。

method_function.text: 测试LLM执行同一评级rubric及对AI批评的反应。

facts.statement: 表22报告GPT4裁判对七模型八维均值及GPT4无辅助行；作者观察辅助让评分更低、严重错误模型与人类方向一致，相近系统排名不同，并称相对人类对OpenAI模型更宽容。这是同rubric比较观察，未做裁判身份隐藏/换位或自偏好机制隔离。

method_function.text: 评价LLM评分者与人类的粗粒度一致及偏好风险。

facts.statement: 按既有人评日志分析筛查/表现/认识各阶段每例平均秒数，认识通常更久且先做表现；另按维度和给分画耗时分布，低分更慢（1/2还需选问题），认识可选I don’t know。Fig14为展示忽略少量>60秒，不能推为全部分析删去这些点。

method_function.text: 描述评价负担及界面选择带来的耗时关联。

facts.statement: 附录Tables23–35逐维好/差回答和辅助影响例子仅作说明：Table24标clarity却以too short/vague解释；Table28对mid1970s题的辅助建议2011–2020数据；Table29高分例也收到不必要的mitigation批评。作者承认辅助可能错误说服，尚需系统缓解，不是已实施排错控制。

method_function.text: 核查rubric实例边界和批评有效性，避免把所有辅助当金标准。

facts.statement: 作者承认无全体gold ratings、答案级主观噪声且rater校准未解决；未来受众定制、视觉信息、系统评估参考文献及AI辅助偏误缓解均未实施。本文存在真实材料probe训练，但没有报告自训回答LLM或用AIS奖励训练；RL背景只是相关工作。

method_function.text: 限定现有评估证据、未实施扩展和训练实际位置。

2.3. Aggregation of scores across dimensions
In this paper we don’t address the important question of
how individual dimensions should be combined in a single
metric, e.g., for model selection and benchmarking. This is
a complex topic which requires assigning a value to each
individual dimension. We also believe that the combination
of these scores will vary by application.

Tone. The tone of a message concerns its perceived neutrality, its persuasiveness and its positivity or negativity.
Science communication, especially climate-related, can be
more effective if it doesn’t lean towards a certain valence,
worldview, or ideological conviction (Blanton & Ikizer,
2019; Yuan & Lu, 2020; Kerr et al., 2022; Munoz-Carrier
et al., 2020). Likewise, messages should not use too positively or negatively valenced language, particularly if the
goal is to convey factual information (Palm et al., 2020).

2.2. Epistemological Adequacy
The epistemological adequacy of climate-related messages
is of greatest importance. This entails several aspects: (1)
accuracy, (2) specificity, (3) completeness, (4) the degree
of (un)certainty, and (5) the presentation of methods and
methodology. Here we focus on the first four.
Accuracy. Scientific information should be accurate (Kelesidou & Chabrol, 2021). This is crucial, considering
known issues of LLMs such as hallucination (Schäfer, 2023;
Ji et al., 2023). We identify issues that deal with incorrect,
wrong, or self-contradictory information, as well messages
that take scientific findings, or anecdotal evidence, out of
context (Hinnant et al., 2016).

Specificity. Information that is relevant to the audience
should not be missed, while ignoring irrelevant information.
Responses should address the spatial and temporal context;
as specific, local information leads to higher perceived relevance (Lee et al., 2015; Leiserowitz & Smith, 2017; Holmes
et al., 2020). In the absence of a specific time frame, the
answer should generally be based on up-to-date knowledge.
Completeness. Rather than only referring to a part of the
question posed, answers should be formulated in a way that
addresses all aspects of the question in full (Leiserowitz &
Smith, 2017; Bergquist et al., 2022). At the same time, the
information given should reflect the depth and breadth of
relevant scientific knowledge available regarding the topic(s)
addressed (Kelesidou & Chabrol, 2021).

Context Dependent Filter. We filter out questions that are taken out of context. The reason that this filter is necessary is
that we generate questions from paragraphs, therefore, some questions are nonsensical when they are not accompanied by
the corresponding Wikipedia paragraph. An example of such a question is: “What are the two classes of climate engineering
discussed in the study?”; without knowing which study is referred to, this question cannot be answered. To develop this filter,
we build a dedicated classifier using in-context probing (Amini & Ciaramita, 2023). Specifically, we manually annotate
100 questions with two labels: context dependent, and not context dependent. Next, we contextualize the question with the
instruction “Write Yes if the query is taken out of context, write No otherwise.” and extract the last layer’s representations of
a flan-xxl encoder (Chung et al., 2022). Finally, we train a logistic regression probing classifier on the representations to
detect context dependent questions. We find the context dependency filter to be 97% accurate on 100 manually annotated
validation questions. Using this classifier, we detect 552 context dependent questions.

Specificity Filter. We remove questions that are asking about a very specific and narrow topic. In our study, we aim
to evaluate large language models on a set of challenging and multifaceted questions that target information needs of
users related to climate change. Therefore, questions that ask for a specific detail are not the target of this study and are
typically easy to answer. An example of such question is: “What was the reason for shutting down reactor number one of

the Fessenheim Nuclear Power Plant on 4 August 2018?” To remove such specific questions, we again build in-context
probing classifier on top of flan-xxl representations. We contextualize each question with the instruction: “Write Yes
if the following query is asking about a specific subject, write No otherwise”. and train the probe on top of extracted
contextualized representations from the last layer of flan-xxl. We find the specificity filter to be 84% accurate on a
sample of 100 annotated validation questions. We detect and remove 5472 specific questions.

A.9. Tutorial and Admission Test
We devise a special introduction session for new participants that contains a tutorial followed by an admission test. The
purpose of the session is twofold: (1) The introduction session is designed to familiarize the raters with the interface and the
task. (2) Based on the session’s outcome we select raters into the rating pool.

Tutorial In the tutorial (see Figure 7) we present 4 examples of increasing difficulty in the rating interface and only ask for
one dimension each. Each example exhibits a particular main issue and we expect raters to identify this issue correctly. A
hint is given if the rater selects a wrong answer that does not identify the issue and they can only proceed to the next item if
an acceptable answer that does identify the issue is given. Regarding other issues than the main issue, one might disagree on
some of these issues and we allow several possible selections. Note that to identify the main issue, a low rating (disagree
completely or disagree) must be selected. Once a valid response is selected we show positive feedback and explain why the
outcome is the desired one. We don’t collect any data during the tutorial part.

after carefully considering possible disagreements or subjective interpretations.

definitely a need to better understand these issues and to

the broader AI alignment field and will be one of the main
focuses of our future work. A related topic is the role of
LLMs as raters. Preliminary experiments are promising

tend to agree on major points.

Ideally, an answer would be tailored towards the audience,
and take into account their specific attributes (Hendriks
et al., 2016; Klinger & Metag, 2021). Unless specifically
prompted, LLMs do not do this and the evaluation of such
setting would introduce additional challenges. Another important area for future work concerns multimodal responses.
Research provides abundant evidence on the importance of
supplementing textual information with visual aids. (Flemming et al., 2018; Brown & Bruhn, 2011). Visual complements can be especially useful for understanding quantitative data (Fagerlin & Peters, 2011) and in the case of limited

change, and its distant implications, makes visualization

model-based, is not a substitute for direct epistemological

6. Related Work

Science and climate communication is more likely to be
trusted if the source is perceived as credible, engaged and
concerned about the audience’s interests (Brown & Bruhn,
2011; Maibach et al., 2023; Hayhoe, 2018). An adequate
presentation of climate information should include curated
references. In future work we plan to extend our framework
to evaluate references in a principled, systematic ways.
